comparison.objective: Hand-guide a Franka arm to a service pose while correctly holding its enabling controls, then teach the pose; candidate removes tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a three-position safety switch in its middle band while moving a seven-joint load, pose by feel, release, and press Teach versus impact-tool stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Arm taught within 1.5 cm and 5 degrees, enabling buttons released, hands clear, without collision or joint-limit events; no fracture criterion.
comparison.reason: Tests safe kinesthetic robot guidance and mode-control sequencing, wholly different from insert finishing.
